title: "Density Readings" graph of film image density vs. frame number
description: Line graph on grid paper titled "DENSITY READINGS" plotting densitometer values (roughly 2.4 to 3.2) against "Frames" numbered 0 to 100, with three overlapping jagged traces. A note at lower right reads "Smallest reading indicating brightest image. Part I" with a legend keying Images 5, 6 and 7, and the sheet is marked "Enclosure 6B." Several struck-through "CONFIDENTIAL SECURITY INFORMATION" stamps cover the chart.
